headlines.title: TTWO Stock In Focus: Citi Says This Blockbuster Game Could Potentially Ease Concerns About Post-GTA VI Earnings Drop
headlines.summary: Citing a Bloomberg interview with Rockstar’s head of publishing, Citi said a Red Dead title releasing in 2027 or 2028 ‘may not be unreasonable.

headlines.title: Take Two Interactive (TTWO) Stock May Be Fully Priced As GTA VI Nears
headlines.summary: Take-Two Interactive Software has seen its share price slip in recent months while anticipation builds around Grand Theft Auto VI, and that mix of excitement and recent weakness puts the focus squarely on whether the current valuation is supported by the cash the business can generate. With investors watching both the game release and the recent share price swings, the question is how well the present market value lines up with the company’s underlying cash flows.

headlines.title: Zacks Investment Ideas feature highlights: Take-Two Interactive
headlines.summary: Take-Two Interactive's upcoming GTA 6 release could reignite stock momentum, with strong franchise demand and FY27 bookings projected to grow 20%.

headlines.title: Should You Be Worried About Take-Two Stock?
headlines.summary: Shares of Take-Two Interactive Software (TTWO) have fallen 21% over the past twelve months, trailing the S&P 500 and its 21% return. Company executives still expect net bookings to grow about 20% in fiscal 2027, aided by the November release of Grand Theft Auto VI. During an August 7 earnings call, however, leadership hesitated to bank on the enthusiasm surrounding the new title. What is management unsure about.

headlines.title: Take-Two shares could reach $300 as GTA VI upside remains unpriced, says Jefferies
headlines.summary: Jefferies has reiterated its "buy" rating on Take-Two Interactive Software Inc (NASDAQ:TTWO), the video game publisher behind Grand Theft Auto, arguing that its shares could reach $300 as investors underestimate the potential of Grand Theft Auto VI.

description: Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. develops, publishes, and markets interactive entertainment solutions for consumers worldwide. The company develops and publishes action/adventure products under the Grand Theft Auto, LA Noire, Max Payne, Midnight Club, and Red Dead Redemption names, as well as other franchises. It also publishes various entertainment properties across various platforms and a range of genres, such as shooter, action, role-playing, strategy, sports, and family/casual entertainment under the BioShock, Mafia, Sid Meier's Civilization, XCOM series, Borderlands, and Tiny Tina's Wonderland names. In addition, the company publishes sports simulation titles comprising NBA 2K series, a basketball video game; the WWE 2K professional wrestling series; mobile titles, including WWE SuperCard; and PGA TOUR 2K. Further, it offers free-to-play mobile games, such as CSR Racing, Dragon City, Empires & Puzzles, FarmVille 3, Game of Thrones: Legends, Golf Rival, Harry Potter: Puzzles & Spells, Hit It Rich!, Match Factory!, Merge Dragons!, Merge Magic!, Monster Legends, NBA 2K, Toon Blast, Top Eleven, Wizard Of Oz Slots Casino, Toy Blast, Words With Friends, and Zynga Poker; and Color Block Jam. The company's products are designed for console gaming systems; and mobiles, such as smartphones, tablets, and personal computers. It provides its products through physical retail, digital download, online platforms, and cloud streaming services. Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. was incorporated in 1993 and is based in New York, New York.
